title: Grant Agreement – Oakland Public Education Fund – Regrant #22-07-05228421 – Pacific Gas and Electric Company

title: Amendment No. 3, General Services Agreement– Ninyo & Moore - Cole Administration Center Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 3, General Services Agreement by and between the District and Ninyo & Moore, Alameda, CA, for the latter to provide further environmental Basic Services, include conducting several soil samplings, preparing an investigation Workplan, a Remedial Action Correction Report, a Supplemental Sampling Investigation (SSI) report, and a Removal Action Workplan for Phase 2, preparing a Remedial Action Correction Report (RACR) documenting the Phase 1 and Phase 2 RAW implementation, as described in the Proposal dated July 21, 2022, attached to this amendment, as part of Exhibit A, for the Cole Administration Center Project, in an additional amount of $184,540.00, which includes an increase of $166,086 for Basic Services, and an increase of $18,454.00 for Additional Services, increasing Agreement not-to-exceed amount from $384,495.00 to $569,035.00. title: Agreement for Engineering Services – Sandis Civil Engineers Surveyors Planners – Melrose Leadership Academy Site Expansion Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement for Engineering Services by and between the District and Sandis Civil Engineers Surveyors Planners, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide site surveying services which include mapping of school property, preparation of topographic survey, and mechanical locating services for subsurface utilities, as described in Article 5 and Exhibit C of the Agreement, for the Melrose Leadership Academy Site Expansion Project, in the amount of $30,470.00, which includes a not-to-exceed amount of $27,700.00 for Basic Services, and a not-to-exceed amount of $2,770.00 for additional services, with work scheduled to commence on September 15, 2022, and scheduled to last until December 31, 2023.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Approves $30,470 for Sandis to survey the Melrose Leadership Academy site for its expansion
summary: The district hires Sandis Civil Engineers Surveyors Planners to map the school property, prepare a topographic survey and locate underground utilities for the Melrose Leadership Academy Site Expansion Project. The total includes $27,700 for basic services and $2,770 for additional services. Work runs from September 15, 2022 to December 31, 2023.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Agreement for Engineering Services - Melrose Leadership Academy Site Expansion Project - Division of Facilities Planning Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement for Engineering Services by and between the District and AGS, Inc., San Francisco, Ca, for the latter to perform a geotechnical field study to explore and evaluate subsurface conditions and develop site-specific geotechnical conclusions including seismic design parameters in accordance with the latest adopted CBC, a corrosion evaluation, and detailed foundation design recommendations; and provide geo­ technical plan review services, as described in Article 5 and Exhibit C of the Agreement, for the Melrose Leadership Academy Site Expansion Project, in the amount of $151,690.00, which includes a not-to-exceed amount of $137,900.00 for Basic Services, and a not-to-exceed amount of $13,790.00 for additional services, with work scheduled to commence on September 15, 2022, and scheduled to last until December 31, 2023.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Approves $151,690 for AGS to study soil and foundation conditions for Melrose Leadership Academy's expansion
summary: The district hires AGS, Inc. to study underground conditions at the Melrose Leadership Academy site, including earthquake design needs, a corrosion evaluation and foundation design advice, and to review the geotechnical plans. The total includes $137,900 for basic services and $13,790 for additional services. Work runs from September 15, 2022 to December 31, 2023.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
